subtitle: 原創模擬題（多益寫作風格）：回覆電子郵件，提供一項資訊並提出兩個問題
task:
Directions: Read the e-mail below. Respond to the e-mail as if you are an employee in the marketing department. In your e-mail, give ONE piece of information and ask TWO questions.

From: Daniel Ross, Facilities Manager
To: Marketing Department staff
Subject: Office move on June 20

Dear colleagues,

As you know, the marketing department will move to the eighth floor on June 20. Movers will pack and transport all furniture and office equipment. Please let me know if any of your equipment needs special handling, and feel free to send me any questions about the move.

Daniel Ross
taskZh: 總務經理 Daniel Ross 寄信通知行銷部：部門將在 6 月 20 日搬到 8 樓，搬家公司會負責打包與搬運家具和設備，如有設備需要特別處理或對搬遷有疑問請回信。請以行銷部員工的身分回信，提供一項資訊，並提出兩個問題。
focus: 任務完成：一項資訊、兩個問題都要寫到，而且容易辨認
組織：開頭回應來信，資訊和問題分段，最後道謝
語氣：同事間的正式書信，禮貌而簡潔
文法與用字：問句語序正確、用字精確

en: Thank you for the information about our move to the eighth floor. I would like to let you know that I have a large color printer at my desk that is quite fragile. It should be moved carefully, so please make sure the movers know about it.

I also have two questions. First, will our computers be ready to use on the first morning after the move, or should we expect any delays? Second, where can we get boxes for packing our personal items? Thank you for your help.
Best regards, Amy Lin, Marketing Department
zh: 謝謝您通知我們搬到 8 樓的相關事宜。我想告訴您，我的座位上有一台相當容易損壞的大型彩色印表機。搬運時需要特別小心，所以請務必讓搬家公司知道這件事。
另外，我有兩個問題。第一，搬完後的第一個早上，我們的電腦能馬上使用，還是可能會有延誤？第二，我們可以去哪裡拿箱子來打包個人物品？謝謝您的協助。
行銷部 林怡安 敬上
